title: What Is Normal HRV by Age? (And When to Worry)
description: Healthy HRV drops ~0.5–1.0 ms per year after 35. Learn what’s normal for your age—and when a 30% monthly drop signals need for action.
reasoning: People are seeing sudden HRV drops on wearables and Googling 'beat to beat variability'—but they’re really asking: 'Is my heart aging too fast?' or 'Could this mean early heart trouble?' They want age-specific, actionable benchmarks—not clinical jargon—and reassurance grounded in real-world wearable data trends.
perplexityQuestions: What is a normal beat-to-beat variability (HRV) for a 35-year-old male?
Is an HRV of 25 ms dangerous for a 45-year-old woman?
Why is my beat-to-beat variability so low at age 50 even though I exercise?
What HRV score indicates heart failure risk in adults over 40?
Is a 30% drop in my HRV from last month a sign of illness at age 38?
